answer: Locks are recorded in glacier, expire in cipher, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 108 aliases thus needs 29 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2191 identities would post 3361 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
